answers.how: The airplane is about 72 px long, giving 40/72 m per pixel. Its center moves about 395 px in 3.40 s, yielding 64.5 m/s.
At 0 s, the gap from the airplane to the rooftop is approximately 115 px. Using 40/72 m per pixel gives about 64 m.
The airplane moves approximately 216 px from 0 to 2.00 s. Multiplying by 40/72 m per pixel gives 120 m.
